latest_release.name: Natron 2.5.0
latest_release.body:
# Known Bugs

- https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/issues/504

### Known issues

- Rendering sometimes silently stalls after X frames. #248
- Some image formats may have issues (PCX, PSB). #602
- MTS video files are sometimes not read correctly. #186

### Changes (compared to 2.4.4)

- Use Python 3 rather than Python 2 (which is not maintained anymore). This will require very few changes to the Python code (mainly print statements), and most code can be easily adapted to be [2-3 compatible](https://python-future.org/compatible_idioms.html). #686
- Use [QtPy](https://github.com/spyder-ide/qtpy/tree/v1.11.2)==1.11.2 rather than PySide. QtPy is an abstraction layer for PyQt5/PyQt4/PySide2/PySide (newer versions support PyQt6/PySide6).  QtPy uses the Qt5 layout (where the QtGui module has been split into QtGui and QtWidgets).  Using QtPy guarantees a higher level of forward-compatibility with future versions of Natron, which may use Qt5 or Qt6. PySide can still be imported explicitly, if required, but the resulting code will not be forward-compatible. Note that 2.4.4 binaries include qtpy, but still import PySide by default. #687

#### Detailed Changes

* RB-2.5: use qtpy rather than pyside by @devernay in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/687
* RB-2.5: python3 support by @devernay in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/686
* Compatibilize with Qt5 in Gui by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/699
* Errata on QWindow header by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/703
* Initial GitHub workflow implementation by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/700
* Support for building with Shiboken2 in Engine by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/697
* Shiboken2 postmerge fixes in Engine by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/704
* Update bug and feature request templates by @Shrinks99 in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/707
* use a different (fake) enum namespace for shiboken & shiboken2 by @devernay in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/713
* Support for building with Shiboken2 in Gui by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/698
* Initial Qt5 sources for Gui by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/716
* Initial Qt5 sources for Engine by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/715
* Deprecate usage of qSort in ToolButton by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/717
* Set tab stop distance with tabStopDistance in Gui by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/718
* Substitute recursive mutex enum with QRecursiveMutex by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/720
* Invoke system in global PySide config by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/721
* Renovate usages of QLineF intersections by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/719
* Query screen geometry using static QGuiApplication methods by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/722
* Renovate QWheelEvent in Gui by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/723
* Index model children with QAbstractItemModel by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/726
* Use QMargins for table model view by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/727
* Use default QFlags construction instead of zero by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/724
* Renovate QString splits with newer enum in Gui by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/725
* Replace qrand with QRandomGenerator in tests by @YakoYakoYokuYoku in https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron/pull/730
* Replace width with horizontal advance for font metrics by @YakoYakoYokuY
